# Live Labels

> Live Labels is a Chrome extension for live sellers. The moment an item sells in a Whatnot or TikTok Shop live show, it prints a label on the seller's thermal label printer with the lot number, buyer username, item, price, the buyer's box number and the seller's logo. Free for 14 days, then $10/month or $99/year. Independent; not affiliated with Whatnot or TikTok.

Not to be confused with other tools that have "Live Labels" in their name. This one is published on the Chrome Web Store as "Live Labels: Auto-Print Sale Labels for Live Sellers" (ID cecmkcfgmebadhpbkjlhcmnnokbjkfke) and posts on Instagram and TikTok as @livelabels.app.

## How it works

1. Add Live Labels to Chrome; a setup wizard connects the label printer and prints a test label (about two minutes).
2. Open the Whatnot or TikTok Shop live show in Chrome.
3. Open the Live Labels side panel and turn on Auto-print.
4. Each auction win or sale prints a label right away.

## Key facts

- Platforms: Whatnot and TikTok Shop live shows in Chrome; other live-selling sites can be added in Settings.
- Label contents: lot number, buyer, item, price, box number, date, header text and the seller's logo (each optional).
- Box numbers: each buyer gets one box number that repeats on every label they buy, so their items go in one package.
- Printers: USB and Bluetooth thermal printers directly from Chrome; any installed printer via Chrome's print dialog; QZ Tray and PrintNode for silent printing. Built-in settings for KNAON, JADENS, Nelko, Rongta, Phomemo, MUNBYN, POLONO, iDPRT, Rollo, Arkscan, Zebra, DYMO, Brother QL.
- Label sizes: 2" x 1" up to 4" x 6", any orientation.
- Also: one-click reprint, manual labels for off-camera sales, optional auto-print of downloaded shipping labels.
- Privacy: sales history, logo and settings stay in the browser; no ads, analytics or tracking.
- Current version: 1.26.0 (October 2026).
